sources.title: 上海汽车博物馆：建筑概念
quotes: 建筑由德国IFB公司和同济建筑设计院完成建筑设计
各个不同层面的露台与屋顶平台
建筑外立面采用大面积的通透玻璃
建筑外观酷似叠加的书本
accepted_facts: Building design credited to German IFB and Tongji architectural design institute.
Flowing curves, large transparent glazing, multiple-level terraces and roof platforms are explicit architectural intentions.
limits: Exhibition concept JRA, content planning Tongji automobile college, and scheme design ATB are separately credited. Do not collapse these into a single structural architect attribution.
No measured overall height, floor heights, curve radii or plan/elevation drawings in the actual body.

sources.title: 上海汽车博物馆：场馆概况
quotes: 建筑面积2.8万平方米，展览面积逾1万平方米
于2006年10月24日正式建成，2007年1月17日正式向公众开放
accepted_facts: Gross floor area approximately28000m²; exhibition area over10000m².
Museum states completion2006-10-24 and public opening2007-01-17.
limits: Not footprint or roof area. No total-floor-count statement in actual body.

sources.title: 上海国际汽车城：上海汽车博物馆
quotes: 占地11700平方米，建筑面积27985平方米
一期开放历史馆和古董车馆，展示面积约5000平方米
accepted_facts: Site area11700m², gross floor area27985m², first-phase exhibition areaapproximately5000m².
limits: Historical phases and opening schedule are not current operational/access evidence.
27985m² is consistent with rounded28000m² but differs from older parks-page28130m²; no enforced reconciliation.

sources.title: 上海汽车博物馆：场馆概况
quotes: 展馆建筑面积2.8万平方米，展区面积逾1万平方米
一楼历史馆、二楼珍藏馆、三楼技术馆以及四楼摩都汽车主题亲子互动空间
accepted_facts: Reaffirms rounded28000m² gross floor area and over10000m² exhibition area.
Describes program on floors1–4 and flowing curves.
limits: Programming on four floors does not establish that the whole building has only four floors.
Does not verify five total floors or individual floor-height measurements.

sources.title: 上海市绿化部门：上海汽车博览公园
sources.source_kind: Government parks page, historical construction-era prose retained online
quotes: 博物馆是上海在建的重点文化工程之一，占地11700㎡，建筑面积28130㎡，建筑高度32.45m
accepted_facts: Explicit museum building height32.45m, site11700m², gross area28130m² in this historical source.
Text distinguishes museum paragraph from following separate Exhibition Center paragraph.
limits: No publication date or height datum stated; wording在建 means this is not an as-built survey certification. Treat32.45m as an official nominal architectural scale, not millimetre accuracy.
28130m² differs from archived Auto City27985m²; record both rather than quietly choosing.
Following6above-ground/1underground floors and61510m² refer to the different Exhibition Center, NOT the museum.
Park opening times do not prove museum entrance, passability or model navigation.

sources.title: Hunter Douglas Architectural：Shanghai Automobile Museum
quotes: At a height of about 32 meters
Constructed from strong, lightweight honeycomb composite
Brushed silver fits the contours atop the building, while dynamic yellow punctuates the windowed walls
accepted_facts: Manufacturer identifies IFB Dr. Braschel AG and approximately32m height.
Honeycomb-composite QuadroClad facade panels, brushed-silver upper contours and yellow window-wall bands support materially distinct exterior modeling.
limits: Approximate32m is consistent with nominal32.45m but adds no exact datum.
Case-study marketing claim of adjacency to Shanghai International F1 Circuit is not adopted as geographic or navigation evidence.
No panel dimensions, exact gloss, measured RGB, joint widths or specified structural cantilever dimensions verified.

sources.title: Hunter Douglas Asia：Shanghai Automobile Museum
accepted_facts: Regional case study lists QC100 within its featured product.
limits: Same manufacturer text is not an independent second architectural authority.
Generic product dimensions must not be substituted for actual installed museum panel sizes.
